en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town with tree‑lined streets and fenced gardens. In the background stands a large historic church with a tall tower and spire, surrounded by compact two‑ and three‑story houses with steep gabled roofs. Telegraph poles line the streets. Along the right border of the image there is handwritten white text on the negative indicating a place name and date.
